kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتزخرف (form IIq)
# نَتَزَخْرَفُ (natazaḵrafu) /na.ta.zax.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَخْرَفَ (tazaḵrafa)
# نَتَزَخْرَفَ (natazaḵrafa) /na.ta.zax.ra.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَخْرَفَ (tazaḵrafa)
# نَتَزَخْرَفْ (natazaḵraf) /na.ta.zax.raf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَخْرَفَ (tazaḵrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
